name: io.github.dimapan-joom/mcp-yandex-direct
title: Yandex Direct MCP (multi-account fork)
description: MCP server for Yandex Direct API v5: multi-account PPC management, full Reports access with revenue/ROAS, and built-in audit tools.

environmentVariables.name: YANDEX_ACCOUNT_<ALIAS>_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: OAuth application ClientID for the account named <ALIAS>.

environmentVariables.name: YANDEX_ACCOUNT_<ALIAS>_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: OAuth refresh token for <ALIAS>; the server renews the access token itself.

environmentVariables.name: YANDEX_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT
environmentVariables.description: Alias used by calls that name no account. Required when several accounts are configured.

environmentVariables.name: YANDEX_DIRECT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Single-account static OAuth token — full account access (can spend budget). Treat it as a secret.

environmentVariables.name: YANDEX_DIRECT_LOGIN
environmentVariables.description: Client login to target a specific client of an agency account.

environmentVariables.name: YANDEX_DIRECT_SANDBOX
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to call the Yandex Direct sandbox API instead of production.

environmentVariables.name: YANDEX_DIRECT_LANG
environmentVariables.description: Language for API responses and error messages (ru, en, ...).
